issues.issue: Whether the psychologist's report and the IRB Response to Information Request are admissible as new evidence
issues.applicant_position: Appellants made no submissions on how the evidence meets admissibility criteria.
issues.result_text: Psychologist's report admitted as new evidence; the RTI is already in the record and need not be admitted.

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing is required under IRPA s.110(6)
issues.applicant_position: No argument that the s.110(6) requirements are met by the psychologist's report.
issues.result_text: Report does not raise a central credibility issue; oral hearing request denied.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the kidnapping allegation fabricated and in questioning on the omission
issues.applicant_position: Kidnapping could have happened; RPD was overzealous in examining testimony.
issues.result_text: RPD wrongly said it had put the omission to him; the negative credibility finding on kidnapping cannot stand.

issues.issue: Whether failure to claim protection in the United States was determinative of credibility
issues.applicant_position: They reasonably explained not seeking protection in the US.
issues.result_text: RPD erred in treating failure to claim in the US as determinative; two days there was not enough to expect it.

issues.issue: Whether a viable internal flight alternative exists in Port Harcourt or Abuja
issues.applicant_position: Fulani herdsmen can track them anywhere; relocation is unreasonable due to unemployment and healthcare.
issues.result_text: Appellants fail both IFA prongs; Port Harcourt IFA is viable, so the appeal is dismissed.
